newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle slow at $70 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle slow at $70 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the Panhandle area Friday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers steady in light test. Feedlots reporting light inquiry.
Sales reported on 1,200 slaughter steers and 700 heifers; following weekly movement of 69,900 head.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1200 lbs 70.00. Select, few Choice 2-3 1150-1200 lbs 69.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1100 lbs 70.00. Pen Select, few Choice 2-3 1050 lbs 68.00.
